name: SRD sample pack
_about: A small pack built from SRD 5.1 material to show the version 2 format. Descriptions are short summaries, not book text. See docs/data-formats.md.

features.name: Rage
features.text: Bonus action: rage for 1 minute. Advantage on Strength checks and saves, extra damage on Strength melee weapon hits, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. Can't cast or concentrate on spells while raging.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.text: Without armor, your AC is 10 + Dex modifier + Con modifier. A shield still counts.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.text: On your first attack of the turn you can attack recklessly: advantage on Strength melee attacks this turn, but attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

effects.text: Reckless Attack: advantage on Strength melee attacks this turn; attacks against you have advantage.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.text: Advantage on Dexterity saves against effects you can see, unless blinded, deafened or incapacitated.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.text: +10 ft speed while not wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Bard spells use Charisma. You know a set number of spells and can swap one each time you gain a level.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.text: Bonus action: give a creature within 60 ft that can hear you an inspiration die to add to one ability check, attack roll or save in the next 10 minutes.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.text: Add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to ability checks you aren't proficient in. Initiative counts.

features.name: Song of Rest
features.text: During a short rest, allies who hear you perform and spend hit dice regain extra HP.

effects.text: Song of Rest: allies who spend hit dice regain an extra 1d6 (1d8 at bard level 9, 1d10 at 13, 1d12 at 17).

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Double your proficiency bonus for two skills you're proficient in.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.text: Bardic Inspiration now comes back on a short or long rest. (Handled by the resource's recharge scale.)

features.name: Fighting Style
features.text: Adopt a style of fighting as your specialty.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + fighter level HP. Once per short rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: Take one extra action on your turn. Once per short rest (twice at 17th level, but only once per turn).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action (three times at 11th, four at 20th).

features.name: Indomitable
features.text: Reroll a failed saving throw; you must use the new roll.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Double your proficiency bonus for two of your skill proficiencies, or one skill and thieves' tools.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.text: Once per turn, extra damage when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and have advantage, or an ally is next to the target and you don't have disadvantage.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.text: A secret mix of dialect, jargon and code that lets you hide messages in normal conversation.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: Bonus action: Dash, Disengage or Hide.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.text: Reaction when an attacker you can see hits you: halve the damage.

features.name: Evasion
features.text: On a Dex save for half damage, take none on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.text: Treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 on ability checks that use a proficiency.

effects.text: Reliable Talent: d20 rolls of 9 or lower count as 10 on proficient checks.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Wizard spells use Intelligence. Your spellbook starts with six 1st-level spells and gains two each level. Each day you prepare Int modifier + wizard level spells from it.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.text: Once a day during a short rest, regain spell slots totalling up to half your wizard level (rounded up), none higher than 5th.

effects.text: Arcane Recovery is available if you haven't used it today.

features.name: Frenzy
features.text: When you rage you can go into a frenzy: one melee weapon attack as a bonus action each turn. You gain a level of exhaustion when the rage ends.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.text: Can't be charmed or frightened while raging.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: Proficiency in three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.text: Reaction: spend a Bardic Inspiration to subtract the die from a creature's attack roll, ability check or damage roll.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.text: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 (18-20 at 15th level).

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.text: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks you aren't proficient in. Running long jumps go farther.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text: Cunning Action can also make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools, or take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text: Climbing costs no extra movement, and running jumps go farther by your Dex modifier in feet.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.text: Copying evocation spells into your spellbook takes half the gold and time.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.text: When you cast an evocation spell that affects others you can see, choose 1 + the spell's level of them to succeed on their saves and take no damage.

effects.text: Sculpt Spells: protect 1 + spell level creatures from your evocation spells.

options.name: Archery
options.text: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

options.name: Dueling
options.text: +2 damage with a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.text: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice for two-handed or versatile melee weapons held in two hands.

options.name: Protection
options.text: Reaction with a shield: impose disadvantage on an attack against a creature within 5 ft of you.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.text: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the off-hand attack.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.text: +2 Constitution.

features.name: Darkvision
features.text: See in dim light within 60 ft as if bright, and darkness as dim.

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.text: Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.text: +1 Wisdom.

features.name: Dwarven Toughness
features.text: +1 max HP per level.

backgrounds.name: Acolyte

features.name: Shelter of the Faithful
features.text: You and your companions can get free healing and care at temples of your faith.

backgrounds.equipment: Holy symbol, prayer book, 5 sticks of incense, vestments, common clothes, 15 gp

feats.name: Grappler
feats.text: Advantage on attacks against a creature you're grappling, and you can try to pin it.

effects.note: Against a creature you are grappling

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.sum: Ranged spell attack. On a hit, 1d10 fire damage; unattended flammable objects ignite.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.sum: A willing creature not wearing armor gets a base AC of 13 + its Dex modifier until the spell ends.

spells.name: Shield
spells.sum: Reaction when hit or targeted by magic missile: +5 AC until your next turn starts, including against the triggering attack.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.sum: A creature you touch regains 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP.

items.name: Pearl of Power
items.text: While attuned, you can speak its command word as an action to regain one spent spell slot of up to 3rd level. Once per dawn.

items.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
items.text: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these.

creatures.name: Skeleton
creatures.languages: Understands languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Vulnerable and immune
traits.text: Vulnerable to bludgeoning. Immune to poison, exhaustion and being poisoned.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Melee weapon attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.text: Ranged weapon attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
